decision.observation: The seaplane hull is at the left edge and a red-orange beach with two palms, banana trees, boulders, driftwood and a rocky shelf lies directly ahead; white surf lines the shore. Pink flipper shapes frame the bottom corners (near-shore swim pose). Stamina bar is dark teal with the hatched tail.
decision.hypothesis: This is the cove beach landfall — shallow surf right in front. Walking forward should put me on dry sand where stamina recovers.
decision.memory: Reached the beach beside the BINGBONG Airways wreck; palms, banana trees and boulders inland.
